guidance.statement: FY27 tractor industry expected to be flattish, 2% to 3% up or down
Industry tractor growth expected at mid-single digit for FY27.
Construction equipment industry growth expected at 12-15% for FY27.
FY27 capex guided at ₹850-900 Cr, including ₹450-500 Cr for greenfield land.
Exports expected to be flat in FY27, with growth in FY28.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Agricultural, Commercial & Construction Vehicles > Tractors

operating_notes.text: Escorts Kubota expanded the Digitrac range to five models spanning the 45-55 HP category.
Escorts Kubota launched three new tractor models (Digitrac PP41i, Digitrac PP43i Plus, and Digitrac PP46i (4WD)) under the Digitrac Series in the 45-55 HP range.
Escorts Kubota sold 10,857 tractors in April 2026, up 24.4% YoY.
Recommended final dividend of ₹33 per share for FY 2025-26.
Board recommended final dividend of ₹33 per share for FY2025-26.
Tractor industry grew 23.4% YoY in FY26 to an all-time high of 11.6 lakh units.
Launched new narrow variant in Kubota NeoStar Series (27HP Range) and upgraded existing variants in 21-27 HP Range.
Introduced Kubota NeoStar series with a new 27HP narrow variant for horticulture and inter-row applications.
Domestic tractor sales at 35,457 units in Q1FY27, up 22.9% YoY, with 36 bps market share gain.
Construction equipment volume at 1,344 machines, up 27.4% YoY.
Captive finance penetration at 10-12% in Q1FY27, reaching 15% in July, with 250 dealers onboarded.

timeline.summary: Escorts Kubota expanded its Digitrac tractor range to a five-model series spanning the 45-55 HP category.

Escorts Kubota Limited’s shareholders approved appointing **Mr. Hitoshi Sasaki (DIN: 11464326)** and **Mr. Satoshi Suzuki (DIN: 06527098)** as directors via remote e-voting on April 24, 2026, with 99.87% and 99.93% votes in favor, respectively.
Escorts Kubota launched three new Digitrac series tractor models in the 45-55 HP range for the domestic market.
Escorts Kubota reported a 24.4% YoY increase in total tractor sales to 10,857 units for April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,968.16 Cr (+21.4% YoY), net profit ₹320.52 Cr (+0.7% YoY).
Escorts Kubota reported standalone Q4FY26 revenue of ₹2,950.7 crore (+21.4% YoY) and net profit of ₹324.8 crore (+29.6% YoY), recommending a final dividend of ₹33 per share.
Escorts Kubota Limited’s **Arvind Kumar** uploaded the May 07, 2026, earnings conference call recording on the company’s website.
On May 11, 2026, Escorts Kubota filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 7, 2026.
Escorts Kubota received a tax penalty order of ₹11.33 lakh from the Ahmedabad Central Mobile Squad for transit goods detention, which it plans to appeal.
On May 28, 2026, Escorts Kubota launched a new narrow variant in the Kubota NeoStar Series (27HP Range) and upgraded existing variants in the 21-27 HP Range.
Escorts Kubota launched the Kubota NeoStar 27HP narrow tractor series targeting horticulture markets.
On May 29, 2026, Escorts Kubota informed exchanges about senior management participation in a social media podcast.
Escorts Kubota Limited’s **Arvind Kumar** scheduled one-on-one/group investor meetings with BofA Securities India Limited on June 3, 2026, 09:00–16:00 (IST).
Escorts Kubota May 2026 tractor sales grow 18.9% YoY to 12,310 units, domestic up 22.5%

Escorts Kubota Limited’s **Arvind Kumar** scheduled one-on-one investor meets with **Invisage Capital Pte Ltd** (June 9, 2026, 15:00–16:00 IST, virtual) and **Anand Rathi Shares and Stock Brokers Ltd** (June 10, 2026, 12:30–13:30 IST, in-person).

Escorts Kubota Limited’s **Arvind Kumar** scheduled one-on-one investor meets with Quantum Advisors Private Limited (June 11, in-person), Enam Asset Management (June 12, virtual), HDFC Mutual Fund (June 15, in-person), and Kotak Securities Limited (June 16, in-person).
Escorts Kubota held its Q1 FY27 earnings call on August 3, 2026, reporting 28% revenue growth to ₹3,208 Cr and guiding mid-single-digit industry growth for FY27.
